notes.title: Patch Notes:
notes.content: - A bug has been fixed that caused the game to only appear in English.

notes.title: Patch Notes:
notes.content:
- A bug has been fixed that caused staff and knights of the club to disappear upon receiving a scouting report.

- A bug has been fixed that prevented using lances in quick tournaments after playing the campaign.

notes.title: Patch Notes V:0.9.1.6
notes.content:
The following changes have been added:

- The ability to rename any knight, staff member, or horse has been added.

- When hovering over the weather icon during a tournament, the penalties caused by the weather conditions will now be displayed.

- Improved pre-tournament screen predictions regarding expected opponents' quality and equipment. Previously, this was based on the overall league, but now it is relative to your team's average.

- Fixed several bugs related to the scouting, recruiting, and renewing mechanics for knights and staff members.

- Added an improvement to the French localization (thanks to @Michael974).

- Fixed a bug that prevented the correct avatar from being displayed on the horse profiles.

- Fixed a bug that prevented horse profiles from noble houses from being opened, impeding their purchase.

- Improved optimization when entering the club and main screens.*

*Attempting to view the full tournament history from the club or main pages is currently a slow process that may still freeze the computer for a while in some cases. The upcoming transition to C++ should resolve this issue.

notes.title: Patch 0.9.1.5 Notes
notes.content:
The following changes have been added:

- Improvements and optimization in how the AI handles training

- Fixed some UI and localization issues

- Added a confirmation pop-up when saving a game, and another one for overwriting a game

- Fixed an issue where the game would attempt to open VR on startup

- Improved optimization for the historical results screen; it still needs more work, and final optimization will come after the transition to C++ is complete

notes.title: Patch 0.9.1.4 Notes
notes.content:
The following changes have been added:

- New icon to represent injuries

- Fixed issues with the sponsorship offers UI

- Fixed a bug that caused phantom sponsorship offers to appear when transitioning between seasons

- Fixed a bug that prevented you from following or adding knights and staff to favorites if they were currently under contract with another club

notes.title: Patch Notes
notes.content:

- The tutorial wouldn’t restart when reactivated in settings

notes.title: Patch Notes

notes.title: Bug Fixes
notes.content:
- Fixed a bug that occasionally occurred when advancing to the next round, preventing the tournament from continuing.

- Fixed a bug that created "phantom" knights after player tournaments, resulting in blank spaces in the tournament results rankings.

notes.title: hotfix
notes.content: - An issue has been fixed that caused some lances to appear empty in certain tournament situations.

notes.title: Immediate Hotfix for Critical Javelin Tournament Start
notes.content:
Dear Users,

A bug was discovered that caused the javelin event to start prematurely. This premature start subsequently led to errors throughout the tournament, affecting event progression, rankings, and match pairings.

I have deployed a hotfix to correct the problem. The hotfix ensures that the javelin event will now start at the correct time, and all subsequent errors in the tournament flow have been addressed.

I apologize for any inconvenience this issue may have caused.

Happy Jousting!

notes.title: Demo release: May 31st
notes.content:
[h1]Demo release: May 31st[/h1]

My lords! My ladies and esteemed guests gathered within these hallowed digital halls, lend me your ears! For I bring tidings of great import, a proclamation that shall echo through the annals of time!

Behold, on the eve of the thirty-first day of May, in the year of our Lord twenty-four, a spectacle unlike any other shall grace the realm of gaming. A demo, a mere taste of the grandeur that awaits, shall be unveiled for all to behold.

Get ready for the ultimate showdown! Mark this day in your calendars, as it will herald the beginning of intense tournaments. Knights will clash in glorious combat upon the field of honor. The jousts will commence, lance against lance, shield against shield, as brave warriors vie for victory.

Spread the word, rally your companions, for the hour of reckoning approaches. May your courage be as steadfast as steel, and victory be your noble steed upon which you ride forth into glory!

notes.title: INTRODUCING JOUSTING MANAGER
notes.content:
[previewyoutube=ljTog-2NMR0;full][/previewyoutube]

[h2]Why this game?[/h2]

I've spent countless weekends scouring Steam for sports management games, always hoping to find one with a medieval twist. So, one Christmas, I decided to take matters into my own hands. Initially, I had a game with just two boxes that changed colors depending on whether they broke a lance. Despite its simplicity, it kept me hooked for weeks. I decided to gradually expand it: first, more game types, then 3D graphics, and eventually, a campaign mode. Four years later, here we are.

[h2]What will you find in the game?[/h2]

The game offers everything sports management enthusiasts love: scouting young talents, hiring staff, planning training sessions, upgrading club facilities, and managing team equipment.

[h2]Current status:[/h2]

We enhance stability and balance to provide access to a fully playable beta. While a few aesthetic additions are pending, such as more stadiums and avatars, we are also working on expanding the campaign event system (optional) and the personality system for the knights.

[b]Join our Discord community![/b] We invite you to be part of this exciting adventure from the beginning. Join our Discord to discuss the game, share your ideas, and engage with the community we are building together.

https://discord.gg/kyMPDu7K

We are thrilled to introduce our game and hope you enjoy the experience as much as we enjoyed creating it. See you on the medieval playing field!
